claims.quote: Fish farms in the Archipelago Sea overfeed by about 15%
New nutrient rules from 2027 make this costly.
Rainbow trout farms in the Turku archipelago and on Åland.
An underwater camera and a small machine-learning model detect when fish stop eating and stop the feeder
Farms pay a subscription per site
We tested a prototype at one farm in Kustavi in August 2026 for three weeks.
